edits.before: Xerath wins by landing Shocking Orb (Stun), denying your pattern, and renting you the lane at a range markup.
edits.after: Xerath wins by out-ranging you with Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction, then stunning any answer with Shocking Orb.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Rebuttal has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): 13s at rank 1 — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts. - Arcanopulse is 9s early: chip in its gap. - His R roots him in a channel your Solar Snare cancels outright — and your 38s Rebuttal reflects the barrages.

edits.before: Q-volley the last-hit, bank the overwhelm stacks, and keep W glowing — the chip is free while his best spells are hostages.
edits.after: Arcanopulse costs 80 mana on a 9s cooldown — volley his last-hits in that gap; he can't answer without bleeding his mana bar.

edits.before: Xerath burns Shocking Orb (Stun) on nothing — take the fifteen-second invitation.
edits.after: Xerath whiffs Shocking Orb — take the 13-second invitation and snare his step-up.

edits.before: Burning Rebuttal on chip and then eating the full rotation it existed to return — the reflect is the matchup; spend it like a verdict.
edits.after: Eye of Destruction falls from above and lands through Rebuttal — the reflect returns Arcanopulse, Shocking Orb and his R barrages only.

edits.before: Q-volley his last-hits — the radiant barrage chips from a range most mids can't answer at one.
edits.after: He out-ranges your Q and autos with Arcanopulse — take only the last-hits you can reach safely.

edits.before: W online: Rebuttal turns his poke into YOUR poke. The reflect re-prices every projectile in the lane.
edits.after: Arcanopulse and Eye of Destruction zone you off CS from safety — Rebuttal answers one, not both.

edits.before: E completes the kit: the snare into full volley is your kill pattern. Hold it for real windows.
edits.after: Shocking Orb completes his artillery: every step-up risks the stun into his full rotation now.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — volley every wave contact and bank the overwhelm stacks on his health bar.
edits.after: He controls the wave and your range with relentless poke — bank stacks only on safe contacts.

edits.before: Golden Eclipse online — the execute threshold turns your chip war into a countdown he can see.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane adds global chip on top of a lane he already runs — his peak, hug tower.

edits.before: Luden's spike: snare-volley chunks half bars and the execute cleans the remainder. Force contacts.
edits.after: Your item spike closes the gap: Rebuttal reflects Arcanopulse or eats his stun — snare his step-up.

edits.before: Late Mel is a counter-artillery battery: reflect their poke, snare their dive, and execute the chipped.
edits.after: Any flank ends an immobile Xerath: reflect the artillery, snare him, and Golden Eclipse cleans up.
